source_title: MV Odyssey suspended its three-year global voyage - Desidime
source_excerpt: The suspension was due to soaring fuel costs, which had increased from an average of $1,800 to an estimated $6,000–$8,000 per cabin monthly, driven by supply chain disruptions from the war in Iran.Passengers, were given only seven hours notice to disembark and have been left stranded with no confirmed departure date or adequate assistance from the operator. ﻿The company stated it could not continue operating due to financial losses and that passing the full fuel cost increase to residents was not a realistic solution.﻿
